domain: llm-inference decode TPOT (TP2 graph runner, local harness)
question: Does the opt-in elementwise/copy candidate (--gated-norm fused, RMSNormGated F.rms_norm) beat shipped defaults (graph + graph scale-cache on + --fp8-config gemv-bk512) exactly and faster?
git_head_note: HEAD f73525a is the shipped baseline (graph decode, graph-scoped scale-cache on, --fp8-config gemv-bk512 default, exact local TPOT 22.112 ms). Candidate is uncommitted working-tree code from prior lane; this round edits no source and commits nothing.

candidates.R5B_base_shipped: --decode-mode graph --scale-cache on --fp8-config gemv-bk512 (shipped defaults; --gated-norm manual default)
candidates.R5C_candidate_gated_fused: identical plus --gated-norm fused (single variable; RMSNormGated.use_fused_rmsnorm, one F.rms_norm/layer)

command_environment.shapes: batch A: all 3 recorded probes (capital, water, counting) x32 greedy in one torchrun; batch B: capital x128 greedy (--probe capital --max-new-tokens 128).
command_environment.ordering: ABBA per batch: B,C,C,B,B,C; 3 measured runs per candidate per shape; 12 torchrun processes, 24 probe-runs; no runs discarded.
command_environment.exactness_x32: runner vs_bridge and vs_arm_a (recorded Arm A probe ids), full 32/32 required, logits finite.
command_environment.exactness_x128: references hold only 32 ids, so x128 exactness = 32/32 prefix vs both references plus full 128/128 agreement against the first base (B) x128 run (within-round rule).
